supplements.title: Characterisation of Xianling Cifang Formula and its metabolites in the mice lung tissue and blood by UHPLC-HR-MS method.
supplements.summary: A Traditional Chinese Medicine formula for breast cancer contains flavonoids and terpenes that reach lung tissue, with icariin identified as a key active compound.

supplements.title: Integrated affinity ultrafiltration UHPLC-QE-Orbitrap-MS and molecular docking for efficient screening of aurora kinase a inhibitors from Eomecon chionantha Hance.
supplements.summary: Researchers identified natural compounds from a plant that effectively block cancer-causing aurora kinase A, with protopine showing the most promise.

supplements.title: Cryptotanshinone suppresses ESCC metastasis by inhibiting macrophage polarization: A mechanistic study elucidating the rationale for cisplatin combination.
supplements.summary: Cryptotanshinone stops esophageal cancer spread by changing immune cells, suggesting it could work better combined with cisplatin treatment.

supplements.title: Clostridium butyricum alleviates DSS-induced colitis by suppressing neutrophil extracellular trap formation via the IL-17 pathway.
supplements.summary: A bacteria called Clostridium butyricum reduces colon inflammation by blocking harmful immune cell traps through the IL-17 pathway.

supplements.title: Combined purslane ethanolic extract and metformin attenuate cognitive dysfunction in HFD/STZ-induced diabetic rats via modulation of oxidative stress, neuroinflammation, and neurotransmitters.
supplements.summary: Purslane extract combined with metformin improved memory problems in diabetic rats by reducing brain inflammation and oxidative stress.

supplements.title: Molecular docking of polyphenols and screening of antioxidant and anticancer activity of Artemisia monosperma leaf extracts in human cancer cells.
supplements.summary: Artemisia monosperma leaf extract kills colorectal and liver cancer cells while sparing healthy cells through DNA damage and apoptosis.

supplements.title: Ameliorative Effect of Green Bimetallic Zinc Oxide-Magnesium Oxide Nanoparticles Against Gastric Ulcer in Rats via Modulation of Oxidative Stress, Inflammatory Cascades, Nrf2/NF-κB Signaling, Angiogenic VEGF Expression.
supplements.summary: Bimetallic zinc-magnesium oxide nanoparticles effectively heal gastric ulcers in rats by reducing inflammation and oxidative stress.

supplements.title: Mechanistic investigation of artesunate against head and neck squamous cell carcinoma through network pharmacology and experimental validation.
supplements.summary: Artesunate kills head and neck cancer cells through mechanisms identified using network analysis and confirmed in experiments.

supplements.title: Comprehensive review on ethnobotany, phytochemistry, and pharmacology of Terminalia phillyreifolia, a traditional medicinal plant.
supplements.summary: Terminalia phillyreifolia plant extracts show cytotoxic effects against cancer cells and possess multiple healing properties, though research needs advancement.

supplements.title: Cytotoxic trichothecene derivatives from Trichothecium sp. DWS815.
supplements.summary: Fungal compounds 7 and 8 stopped cancer cell growth by halting cell division in colorectal cancer cells.

supplements.title: Joint association of physical activity and tea consumption with all-cause and cause-specific mortality: The Rural Chinese Cohort Study.
supplements.summary: Regular physical activity and tea consumption together may reduce mortality risk in rural Chinese populations.

supplements.title: Sodium butyrate suppresses endometrial cancer cell growth by inhibiting thymidylate synthase and reprogramming pyrimidine metabolism.
supplements.summary: Sodium butyrate suppresses endometrial cancer cell growth by blocking a key enzyme and altering how cells produce DNA building blocks.

supplements.title: The preclinical evidence and clinical translational prospects of medicarpin.
supplements.summary: Medicarpin, a traditional Chinese medicine compound, shows promise in early cancer studies but requires clinical testing before human use.

supplements.title: Assessment the Effects of Roasted and Non-Roasted Coffee Extracts on Colon Cancer Cells.
supplements.summary: Roasted coffee extract slowed colon cancer cell growth more effectively than unroasted coffee extract in laboratory tests.

supplements.title: The Clinical Benefits of Nutritional Supplementation Across the Chemotherapy Journey in Cancer Patients: A Multicenter Prospective Cohort Study.
supplements.summary: Nutritional supplements during chemotherapy helped cancer patients better tolerate treatment and maintain health throughout their cancer care journey.

off_label.title: GLS1 Orchestrates Exosome-Mediated Tumor-Endothelial Communication to Facilitate Angiogenesis.
off_label.summary: GLS1 protein promotes blood vessel growth in head and neck cancer by packaging pro-angiogenic molecules into exosomes that signal to blood vessel cells.

off_label.title: Combined purslane ethanolic extract and metformin attenuate cognitive dysfunction in HFD/STZ-induced diabetic rats via modulation of oxidative stress, neuroinflammation, and neurotransmitters.
off_label.summary: Purslane extract combined with metformin improved memory problems in diabetic rats by reducing brain inflammation and oxidative stress.

off_label.title: Spatially resolved ex vivo drug response profiling in SMARCB1-deficient sinonasal carcinoma.
off_label.summary: mTOR inhibitor Sapanisertib effectively kills aggressive sinonasal carcinoma cells by targeting stem-like tumor populations in patient tissue samples.

off_label.title: Acarbose modulates microglial Pkm2 acetylation to reshape immunometabolism and preserve retinal neurons after ischemia-reperfusion.
off_label.summary: Acarbose protects retinal neurons from injury by reducing harmful inflammation and restoring energy metabolism through a specific protein modification pathway.

off_label.title: In silico analysis of gene expression signatures and drug repurposing associated with metastatic progression in melanoma (skin cancer).
off_label.summary: Researchers identified five key genes driving melanoma spread and found two existing drugs that could potentially target these genes in metastatic skin cancer.

off_label.title: Combination of Lenvatinib and Antibiotics: A Potential Approach to Enhance Sensitivity in Differentiated Thyroid Cancer.
off_label.summary: Combining lenvatinib with antibiotics tigecycline or eravacycline enhances cancer cell death in lenvatinib-resistant differentiated thyroid cancer by disrupting mitochondrial function.

off_label.title: Metformin counteracts lipid accumulation and cell proliferation in hepatocellular carcinoma via regulating METTL3-mediated m6A methylation.
off_label.summary: Metformin reduces lipid buildup and cancer cell growth in liver cancer by decreasing a protein that modifies RNA structure.

off_label.title: Arvanil reverses cisplatin resistance in ovarian cancer by activating HMOX1-driven ferroptosis.
off_label.summary: Arvanil combined with cisplatin overcomes drug resistance in ovarian cancer by triggering a cell death process called ferroptosis.

off_label.title: Transient p53/p21 activation selectively protects healthy human hair follicles and their stem cells from chemotherapy.
off_label.summary: A drug called ALRN-6924 protects healthy hair follicles and stem cells from chemotherapy damage by temporarily halting their growth.

off_label.title: Modulating IL-1β-induced pro-atherogenic endothelial responses through drug repurposing.
off_label.summary: Researchers identified affordable, oral drugs that block IL-1β inflammation to protect blood vessels and prevent atherosclerosis development.

off_label.title: Zoledronic Acid Inhibits the Growth of ER-Positive Breast Cancer Cells by Inducing Ferroptosis.
off_label.summary: Zoledronic acid kills estrogen receptor-positive breast cancer cells by triggering ferroptosis, a cell death process distinct from apoptosis.

off_label.title: Simultaneous Establishment of Autologous Colorectal Cancer and Mesothelial Stromal Cell Lines from Malignant Ascites Reveals a Mesothelial-Stromal FGFR3 Axis as a Potential Vulnerability in Peritoneal Metastasis.
off_label.summary: Researchers identified a mesothelial-stromal FGFR3 axis as a potential therapeutic target in colorectal cancer peritoneal metastasis.

off_label.title: BPGM as an intrinsic brake to constrain metastasis through phospho-epigenetic-mediated carnitine biosynthesis suppression.
off_label.summary: Researchers identified BPGM as a natural brake on cancer metastasis by blocking carnitine production that fuels tumor spread.

off_label.title: Effect of statin use on prognostic outcomes in hepatocellular carcinoma following liver surgery: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
off_label.summary: Statins significantly improve survival and reduce recurrence in hepatocellular carcinoma patients after liver surgery or transplant.

off_label.title: Exploration of BMI and circulating metabolic factors as predictors of metformin benefit in CCTG MA.32.
off_label.summary: Metformin showed potential benefit in HER2-positive breast cancer patients, with obesity-related blood markers possibly predicting treatment response.

biomarkers.title: Trial watch: antibody-drug conjugates in cancer therapy.
biomarkers.summary: Antibody-drug conjugates combine targeting antibodies with toxic payloads, demonstrating clinical benefit across blood and solid cancers with improved survival outcomes.

biomarkers.title: Integrative analysis of adiponectin-related genes reveals immune subtypes and prognostic significance in melanoma.
biomarkers.summary: Adiponectin-related genes predict survival outcomes and immune responses in melanoma patients.

biomarkers.title: Boron-Doped AIE Nanomaterials With NIR-II Emission for FL/MR Dual-Modality Tumor Imaging.
biomarkers.summary: Boron-doped nanomaterials enable dual-mode fluorescence and MRI imaging of tumors with enhanced detection and biocompatibility.

biomarkers.title: Characterisation of Xianling Cifang Formula and its metabolites in the mice lung tissue and blood by UHPLC-HR-MS method.
biomarkers.summary: A Traditional Chinese Medicine formula for breast cancer contains flavonoids and terpenes that reach lung tissue, with icariin identified as a key active compound.

biomarkers.title: Impact of Genomic Mutations on the Transcriptional Pathways and Tumor Microenvironment Landscape of Localized Early Prostate Cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified how specific genetic mutations in early prostate cancer affect tumor behavior and immune environment, helping distinguish aggressive from slow-growing tumors.

biomarkers.title: Comprehensive Multi-Omics Profiling of Tertiary Lymphoid Structures Reveals Immunogenetic Landscapes and Prognostic Subtypes in Lung Adenocarcinoma.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified immune-related genes in lung adenocarcinoma tumors that predict patient outcomes and guide targeted drug treatment selection.

biomarkers.title: AI and the digital pathology revolution: clinical applications in cancer diagnosis and assessment.
biomarkers.summary: AI-powered digital pathology tools improve cancer diagnosis accuracy and enable remote analysis of tissue slides while reducing human error.

biomarkers.title: Circulating KIM-1 as a Prognostic Biomarker and Predictor of Systemic Treatment Response in Renal Cell Carcinoma: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
biomarkers.summary: KIM-1 blood levels show promise as a biomarker for predicting survival and treatment response in kidney cancer patients.

biomarkers.title: GLS1 Orchestrates Exosome-Mediated Tumor-Endothelial Communication to Facilitate Angiogenesis.
biomarkers.summary: GLS1 protein promotes blood vessel growth in head and neck cancer by packaging pro-angiogenic molecules into exosomes that signal to blood vessel cells.

biomarkers.title: A lipid nanoparticle-based peptide-proteolysis-targeting chimera degrades BCL6 for diffuse large B-cell lymphoma treatment.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed a new nanoparticle treatment that destroys BCL6 protein in diffuse large B-cell lymphoma cells while maintaining safety.

biomarkers.title: Deciphering the potential pathogenic mechanisms of 3-BHA in ovarian cancer through integrated bioinformatics and machine learning strategies.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified five genes that 3-BHA may activate to promote ovarian cancer, with CXCR2 overexpression linked to poor outcomes.

biomarkers.title: Biological characterization of an avian leukosis virus subgroup J isolate from yunnan indigenous black-bone chickens and generation of its full-length infectious clone.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers isolated a highly pathogenic avian leukosis virus from chickens that reduced egg production and weight, then created an infectious clone for studying prevention strategies.

biomarkers.title: Responsiveness and clinical utility of patient-reported outcome instruments in head and neck cancer: a systematic review.
biomarkers.summary: Patient-reported quality-of-life tools can reliably measure treatment outcomes and guide care decisions in head and neck cancer patients.

biomarkers.title: The autophagy-inhibitory tissue hormone DBI/ACBP is essential for glucocorticoid-induced immunosuppression.
biomarkers.summary: Glucocorticoid-induced immunosuppression works through a hormone called DBI/ACBP, offering a new target to restore cancer immune responses.

biomarkers.title: From histological and molecular pathology to the inclusion of antibody-drug conjugates in clinical practice against ovarian cancers: Mechanisms of action and pharmacological safety.
biomarkers.summary: Antibody-drug conjugates show promise for advanced ovarian cancer, achieving better survival with fewer side effects than traditional chemotherapy.

trials.title: Spiritual Well-Being Moderates the Association Between Attachment Insecurity and Death Anxiety in Chinese Patients With Metastatic Breast Cancer: Indirect Pathways Through Distress and Depressive Symptoms.
trials.summary: Spiritual well-being helps reduce death anxiety in metastatic breast cancer patients by lowering distress and depression.

trials.title: Trial watch: antibody-drug conjugates in cancer therapy.
trials.summary: Antibody-drug conjugates combine targeting antibodies with toxic payloads, demonstrating clinical benefit across blood and solid cancers with improved survival outcomes.

trials.title: Perioperative Safety and Early Oncologic Outcomes of Salvage Irreversible Electroporation for Radiorecurrent Prostate Cancer.
trials.summary: Salvage irreversible electroporation shows safe, effective early results for treating prostate cancer that recurs after radiation therapy.

trials.title: Real-World Treatment Patterns and Clinical Outcomes Among Chinese Patients with Stage III NSCLC: The MOOREA Study.
trials.summary: Study reveals actual treatment practices and patient outcomes for stage III lung cancer in China under current therapy approaches.

trials.title: A lipid nanoparticle-based peptide-proteolysis-targeting chimera degrades BCL6 for diffuse large B-cell lymphoma treatment.
trials.summary: Researchers developed a new nanoparticle treatment that destroys BCL6 protein in diffuse large B-cell lymphoma cells while maintaining safety.

trials.title: Health-related quality of life measures in incarcerated populations: a scoping review.
trials.summary: This review examines how well-being is measured in incarcerated people, who face higher disease rates and health challenges.

trials.title: Responsiveness and clinical utility of patient-reported outcome instruments in head and neck cancer: a systematic review.
trials.summary: Patient-reported quality-of-life tools can reliably measure treatment outcomes and guide care decisions in head and neck cancer patients.

trials.title: From histological and molecular pathology to the inclusion of antibody-drug conjugates in clinical practice against ovarian cancers: Mechanisms of action and pharmacological safety.
trials.summary: Antibody-drug conjugates show promise for advanced ovarian cancer, achieving better survival with fewer side effects than traditional chemotherapy.

trials.title: An evaluation of avutometinib in combination with defactinib for KRAS-mutated recurrent low-grade serous ovarian cancer.
trials.summary: A combination drug treatment targets KRAS mutations in recurrent low-grade serous ovarian cancer, addressing a previously hard-to-treat cancer type.

trials.title: Laparoscopic partial hepatectomy for primary hepatic PEComa: a case report.
trials.summary: Surgeons successfully removed a rare liver tumor (PEComa) using minimally invasive laparoscopic surgery in a young patient.

trials.title: Combined Preoperative Risk Score Including sCD40, Leukocytes, and BMI Predicts Pancreas-Specific Complications After Pancreatic Cancer Surgery.
trials.summary: A blood test combining three factors predicts complications after pancreatic cancer surgery, helping doctors identify high-risk patients beforehand.

trials.title: Radiotherapy combined with immunotherapy for esophageal cancer: current status and challenge.
trials.summary: Combining radiotherapy with immunotherapy shows promise for esophageal cancer by boosting the body's anti-tumor immune response.

trials.title: Prostate cancer detection in routine clinical practice: a large cohort study in Japan.
trials.summary: Without organized screening in one Japanese region, prostate cancer diagnoses shifted toward older, higher-risk patients, though active surveillance increased.

trials.title: Translational feasibility of a plasmonic microarray-based liquid biopsy for KRAS codon mutation detection across tissue, plasma, and urine in early colorectal cancer.
trials.summary: Researchers developed a highly sensitive test detecting colorectal cancer mutations in blood and urine samples, matching tissue biopsy accuracy for early diagnosis.

trials.title: Development and external validation of an interpretable multimodal deep learning model for 5-year mortality in high-risk stage ii colorectal cancer.
trials.summary: Researchers created an AI model using medical scans, blood tests, and patient data to predict which high-risk colorectal cancer patients may die within five years.
